plans.lead: The main comparison page. Prices keep their original currency; the converted currency is derived; vendor wording (Unlimited / Fair Use, etc.) is quoted verbatim.
plans.empty: No plan data yet (run planscope export-site-data first).
plans.compatNote: Compatibility values: full / officially_supported / partial / unofficial / unsupported / unsupported_by_plan / unknown —— “OpenAI-API compatible” does not mean “fully compatible”; officially_supported = explicitly supported in the official docs (not exhaustively re-verified); unsupported_by_plan = the platform supports it but this plan does not include it (e.g. Go has no Kimi Code). Plans that cannot honestly be converted to a unit price are marked not directly comparable instead of being force-estimated.
